config system global
    set alias "FGT-TEST"
    set hostname "FGT-TEST"
    set timezone 04
end
config system admin
    edit "admin"
        set accprofile "super_admin"
        set vdom "root"
        set password ENC DUMMYENCVALUEAAAA0001
    next
end
config system interface
    edit "port1"
        set vdom "root"
        set ip 192.0.2.1 255.255.255.0
        set allowaccess ping https ssh
        set type physical
        set description "uplink to core"
        set alias "wan"
        set role wan
        set snmp-index 1
        set speed 1000full
        set vrf 0
        config ipv6
            set ip6-address ::/0
            unset ip6-allowaccess
        end
        config secondaryip
            edit 1
                set ip 192.0.2.65 255.255.255.192
            next
        end
    next
    edit "port2"
        set vdom "root"
        set mode dhcp
        unset allowaccess
        set type physical
        set status down
        set description ''
        set ip 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0
        set mtu-override enable
    next
    edit "vlan100"
        set vdom "root"
        set ip 198.51.100.1 255.255.255.0
        set interface "port1"
        set vlanid 100
        set type vlan
    next
    edit "ssl.root"
        set vdom "root"
        set type tunnel
        set alias "SSL VPN interface"
    next
    edit "loop0"
        set vdom "root"
        set ip 203.0.113.1 255.255.255.255
        set type loopback
    next
    edit "agg1"
        set vdom "root"
        set type aggregate
        set member "port3" "port4"
    next
end
config system replacemsg admin "pre_admin-disclaimer-text"
    set buffer "<html><body>
<form action=\"/login\" method=\"post\">
   %%OVERRIDE%%
     end
       next
config system interface
    set allowaccess telnet
 It's a test page.
</form></body></html>"
    set format html
end
config vpn certificate local
    edit "test-cert"
        set password ENC DUMMYENCVALUEBBBB0002
        set comments ''
        set private-key "-----BEGIN ENCRYPTED PRIVATE KEY-----
DUMMYKEYLINE0001
DUMMYKEYLINE0002
-----END ENCRYPTED PRIVATE KEY-----"
        set certificate "-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
DUMMYCERTLINE0001
-----END CERTIFICATE-----"
    next
end
config firewall address
    edit "SSL-VPN"
        set subnet 192.0.2.128 255.255.255.128
    next
end
config firewall policy
    edit 1
        set name "allow out"
        set srcintf "port2"
        set dstintf "port1"
        set action accept
        set service "ALL"
    next
end
config user local
    edit "user1"
        set type password
        set passwd ENC DUMMYENCVALUECCCC0003
    next
end
